statements.name: Statement of financial position
statements.legal_reference: Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020, s. 377(2)(b) requires "the balance sheet or balance sheet as at the last day of the year" among the financial statements the directors prepare; s. 378(1) requires it to comply with the First Schedule to the Act "so far as applicable" and with the accounting standards the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria lays down. The lines below follow the First Schedule, Section C, Balance Sheet Formats, Format 1 — a vertical format, headed A to M — summarised to the level of this chart's own account blocks; each heading below names the paragraph of Format 1 it carries.

lines.name: Called up share capital not paid
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item A.

lines.name: Intangible fixed assets
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item D — development costs, concessions, patents, licences, trademarks and goodwill, net of accumulated amortisation.

lines.name: Tangible fixed assets
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item B — land and buildings, plant and machinery, fixtures, fittings, tools and equipment, and construction-in-progress, net of accumulated depreciation.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item C.

lines.name: Fixed assets and long-term investments
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, items B, C and D combined.

lines.name: Stocks
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item E.I.

lines.name: Trade and other debtors
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item E.II — trade debtors and other debtors, including amounts recoverable from the Service and from the Nigeria Customs Service.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item E.III.

lines.name: Cash at bank and in hand
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item E.IV.

lines.name: Prepayments and accrued income
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item F.

lines.name: Current assets
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item E plus item F.

lines.name: Creditors: amounts falling due within one year
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item G.

lines.name: Net current assets (liabilities)
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item H.

lines.name: Total assets less current liabilities
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item I.

lines.name: Creditors: amounts falling due after more than one year
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item J.

lines.name: Provisions for liabilities and charges
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item K.

lines.name: Accruals and deferred income
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item L.

lines.name: Net assets
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1 — item I less items J, K and L.

lines.name: Called up share capital
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item M.1.

lines.name: Share premium account
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item M.2.

lines.name: Revaluation reserve
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item M.3.

lines.name: Other reserves
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item M.4 — capital redemption reserve, statutory reserve and other reserves.

lines.name: Retained earnings
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item M.V — profit and loss account balance carried from the income statement, net of dividends paid.

lines.name: Capital and reserves
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Format 1, item M.

statements.name: Statement of profit or loss
statements.legal_reference: Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020, s. 377(2)(c) requires "a profit and loss account […] for the year" among the financial statements the directors prepare; s. 378(1) requires it to comply with the First Schedule to the Act "so far as applicable". The lines below follow the First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1 (the function-of-expense format), summarised to the level of this chart's own account blocks.

lines.name: Turnover
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 1, net of sales returns, allowances and discounts allowed.

lines.name: Cost of sales
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 2.

lines.name: Gross profit or loss
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 3.

lines.name: Distribution expenses
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 4.

lines.name: Administrative expenses
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 5.

lines.name: Other operating income
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 6 — rental income, grants, profit on disposal of fixed assets, foreign exchange gains and income from investments.

lines.name: Other operating expenses
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 11 — bad debts, depreciation and amortisation not carried in cost of sales, loss on disposal of fixed assets, foreign exchange losses, rounding, withholding tax suffered and the fossil fuel surcharge of Nigeria Tax Act 2025, Chapter Seven.

lines.name: Operating profit or loss
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1 — items 3 and 6 less items 4, 5 and 11.

lines.name: Interest payable and similar charges
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 12.

lines.name: Profit or loss on ordinary activities before taxation
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, the figure items 13 and 14 are computed from.

lines.name: Tax on profit or loss on ordinary activities
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 13 — Companies Income Tax, deferred taxation and the Development Levy of Nigeria Tax Act 2025, s. 59.

lines.name: Profit or loss for the financial year
lines.legal_reference: First Schedule, Section C, Profit and Loss Account Formats, Format 1, item 14.
